choice.basis: The dashboard (chart_1) plots monthly discharge as vertical bar height on a shared 'Discharge Level Index' axis (0–500, ticks every 100). A dashed horizontal reference line is labeled 'Average' (the monthly-average benchmark). The top edge of the January bar is horizontally aligned with that dashed 'Average' line (both at the ~445 level). Because the bar height encodes discharge and the reference line marks the average, alignment means January's reported discharge equals the monthly-average benchmark — neither above (elevated) nor below (reduced).
choice.option_label: Route January to average-band discharge monitoring
